# Artifact Gateway v0.8.1

## 简体中文

修复 #321：OCI 上传锁和对象发布锁改用现有有界 artifact-lock 池，不再在对象存储 I/O 期间占用主元数据池。上传完成向对象锁传递同一 session，锁池只有一条连接时也不会因嵌套借用另一条连接而停住。取消取锁和解锁失败时丢弃物理连接，解锁清理最多使用 5 秒预算。既有 advisory key 及跨实例发布/回收互斥保持一致；不通过增大主池上限掩盖问题，也不清理未完成上传记录。

本次不增加或修改 SQL migration；144 项文件/checksum 与正式 v0.8.0 完全相同。对象 key、格式和字节规则不变，既有配置可沿用。Gateway、Console、OpenAPI 与发行材料统一为 0.8.1；本补丁不包含未合入的 Console 重构。

### 从正式 v0.8.0 升级与回退

1. 窗口前下载正式包和 `SHA256SUMS`，校验所选资产后解包到独立版本目录。核对 `VERSION.txt`、`gateway version` 和精确发行 revision；保留 v0.8.0 二进制、现有服务启动方式、配置及独立加密/签名 key，避免覆盖数据目录。确认目标 144 项 ledger/checksum 与包完全相同；不要把旧 schema 142 的恢复库作为本次回退目标。
2. 复用[恢复手册](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.8.1/docs/recovery-runbook.zh-CN.md)的成熟备份流程，提前完成可做的包验证、备份准备和元数据 dump。单个在线 PG dump 不是完整 PG/S3 配对恢复证据；必要的一致写入者范围和对象恢复点仍须验证。保留最新一致备份、配置和 key，不因补丁无迁移而省略恢复准备。
3. 暂停新增 CI 写入，核实实际活动请求/锁及任务，排空或可恢复地停止写入者。数据库中的未完成 upload 行数不证明它们活跃，也不是清理授权。完成必要一致备份后，按现有部署 wrapper 切换 Gateway/Console 到同一发行 revision，将停机集中在切换与 Gateway 重启窗口；没有 schema/对象迁移，不要求因此重启 PostgreSQL/RustFS 或重新复制全部制品。
4. 检查 `/livez`、`/readyz`、节点版本和主池/artifact-lock 池指标；用既有读取身份核验已知制品，并在业务镜像并发推送期间持续核验 readiness 和其他读取。确认 manifest/config/layers/digest、扫描与 Kubernetes 冷拉取后再恢复全部写入。仓库 CI 和合成回归不代替目标环境验收。
5. 对本次相同 144 schema/对象格式边界，二进制回退可暂停写入并切回保留的正式 v0.8.0 软件及配置，保留当前数据；它也会重新带回旧并发上传缺陷。隔离回归已用校验过的原始 v0.8.0 二进制完整读取修复生成的 manifest/config/31 层共约 9.2 MB 内容，readiness 为 204；这个证明不覆盖任意其他 schema/版本或全部业务制品。如怀疑数据损坏，停止写入并使用最新验证过的同组 PG/S3 备份执行独立恢复，不套用旧库或 down migration。

发行完成与生产升级完成分开记录。实际应用镜像推送、扫描及运行时冷拉取仍由部署负责人验收。

## English

Fix #321: OCI upload and object-publication advisory locks use the existing bounded artifact-lock pool instead of holding metadata-pool connections during object I/O. Upload completion carries the same session into the nested object lock, including with a one-connection lock pool. Cancelled acquisitions and failed unlocks discard the physical session; unlock cleanup has a five-second budget. Existing advisory keys and cross-instance publication/reclaim exclusion remain intact. This does not increase the main-pool limit or remove incomplete upload records.

No SQL migration is added or changed: all 144 files/checksums match formal v0.8.0. Object keys, format and byte rules are unchanged, and existing configuration remains valid. Gateway, Console, OpenAPI and distribution materials use 0.8.1. Unmerged Console redesign work is excluded.

### Upgrade and rollback from formal v0.8.0

1. Before the window, download the formal asset and `SHA256SUMS`, verify the selected asset, and extract into a separate version directory. Check `VERSION.txt`, `gateway version` and the exact release revision. Retain v0.8.0 binaries, the existing service wrapper/configuration and independent encryption/signing keys; never overwrite data directories. Confirm the target's full 144-entry ledger/checksums match. A schema-142 recovery database is not this patch's rollback target.
2. Reuse the established [recovery runbook](https://github.com/ccsert/artifact-gateway/blob/v0.8.1/docs/recovery-runbook.md). Complete asset verification, backup preparation and metadata dumps early where possible. An online PG dump alone is not paired PG/S3 recovery evidence; verify the complete writer boundary and recoverable object checkpoint. Retain a current consistent backup, configuration and keys even for this migration-free patch.
3. Pause new CI writes, inspect actual active requests/locks and jobs, and drain or resumably stop writers. Incomplete upload rows are neither proof of activity nor permission to remove them. After the required consistent backup, use the existing deployment wrapper to switch Gateway/Console to the same release revision and concentrate downtime in the switch/restart window. This patch requires no PostgreSQL/RustFS restart, schema/object migration, or full artifact recopy.
4. Check health endpoints, node build identity and main/artifact-lock pool metrics. Verify known artifacts with existing read identities while concurrent application-image pushes run; check all manifest/config/layer digests, scanning and Kubernetes cold pulls before reopening every writer. Repository CI and synthetic fixtures do not establish target acceptance.
5. Within this identical 144-entry schema/object-format boundary, pause writes and switch back to the retained formal v0.8.0 software/configuration while keeping current data; its original concurrency defect returns as well. A checksum-verified original v0.8.0 binary read the candidate-generated manifest/config/31 layers, about 9.2 MB, with readiness 204 in an owned isolated fixture. This is not proof for arbitrary versions/schemas or every business artifact. Suspected data damage requires separate recovery from a current validated paired PG/S3 backup, never an older unrelated database or down migration.

Record publication and production rollout separately. Application push, scanning and runtime cold-pull acceptance belong to the deployment owner.
